author: Phoenix
modifications: Wrap and tank-pad patterns (carbon, matte, racing stripe, urban camo, chequer, flame) drawn to a canvas at runtime. Zero bytes. Effect.texture.map takes a real URL instead the moment artwork exists.

author: Phoenix
modifications: Single-cylinder exhaust note synthesised with the Web Audio API: a custom PeriodicWave per exhaust, resonant low-pass, waveshaper drive and filtered noise. Three profiles (stock / slip-on / full system) plus a rev sweep. Zero bytes against the 400 kB audio budget. Superseded by pointing SoundSet.idleUrl at a licence-verified CC0 clip from Freesound.

author: Generated by Hisan (Phoenix) with Tripo AI
modifications: AI-generated 4-door sedan, supplied PART-SEPARATED (56 meshes, 110,719 triangles, already inside the §13 budget). Processed by scripts/model/prepare-vehicle.mjs: GEOMETRY UNTOUCHED at the high LOD — no decimation, which is what crushed the earlier fused model. Node transforms baked flat, parts renamed to the §13 semantic names by exterior-visibility plus baked-colour classification, the Toyota grille emblem and the invented number plate repainted out of their own textures, then yawed 90 degrees and scaled to the 4.626 m placeholder footprint and meshopt-compressed at three LODs. The /demo/360 turntable is 32 frames rendered from the same model.

author: Generated by Hisan (Phoenix) with Tripo AI
modifications: AI-generated sport naked motorcycle, supplied PART-SEPARATED (102 meshes, 116,245 triangles, already inside the §13 budget). Processed by scripts/model/prepare-vehicle.mjs with GEOMETRY UNTOUCHED at the high LOD: parts renamed to §13 semantic names (body_paint = tank, tail panels, front mudguard, fork guards), scaled to a 2.02 m footprint and meshopt-compressed at three LODs. No manufacturer badge present on this model.

author: Generated by Hisan (Phoenix) with Tripo AI
modifications: AI-generated circular showroom stage (turntable disc + slatted curved backdrop + light-rig frame, supplied as ONE fused mesh, 133,791 triangles, 6.5 MB with a 4096² JPEG atlas). Processed by scripts/model/prepare-stage.mjs: welded, simplified to 44,994 triangles, atlas resized to 1024 webp, inert KHR_materials_volume dropped, meshopt-compressed — 0.43 MB shipped. Geometry arrives fused, so the frame ships with the stage and reads as the rig it is under the dark tint. Floors every 3D bay via src/lib/stage-platform.ts.
